_README: This file is managed by LazyCue (see shelley/lazycue). Do NOT edit by hand — it is the cached, machine-generated DSL for a self-healing browser test. To change behavior, edit the test description and re-run LazyCue.
description: Changed settings are saved as a profile, which is edited and switched. Call "last system prompt" returns "ok" when the conversation's last system message's text is "Be brief in " followed by an absolute path and ".\n" (otherwise that text, JSON-encoded). The screen is a 1280x800 desktop window. Name elements by ARIA role and accessible name, as Playwright's getByRole does; "named X" means an exact name match, "whose name contains X" a substring one. "The panel" is ".model-picker-panel". To "open the knob": click ".model-picker-inline .p-select-label"; the panel should be visible. To "edit tools": click the button whose name contains "Edit" inside the panel's data-testid "model-picker-tools"; the panel should be hidden. "The pills" are data-testid "model-picker-profiles"; "the profile X" is the radio (role "radio") named X inside them. To "edit profiles": click the button whose name contains "Edit" inside the pills. "The section" is data-testid "model-picker-auto-compaction"; "the section's X" is the radio named X inside it, and "the nudge" is its select (role "combobox"). "The dialog" is the element with role "dialog". "The X tool" is the dialog's radiogroup with aria-label X ('[role=radiogroup][aria-label="X"]'). "The auto compaction row" is the dialog's data-testid "auto-compaction". To "apply": click the dialog's button whose name contains "Apply to this conversation"; the dialog should be hidden. "The markers" are the data-testid "message-modelchange" elements. "Changed" is the panel's data-testid "model-picker-profile-changed". To "save as new" a name N: click changed's button whose name contains "Save as new…", fill changed's textbox named "New profile name" with N and press Enter in it. A "row" X is the dialog's data-testid "profile-row" containing the text X. "The prompt" is the dialog's textbox named "System prompt template"; "save" is the dialog's button whose name contains "Save". Perform the steps in order. 1. Navigate to /c/{{SLUG}}, open the knob and edit tools. Click the browser tool's radio whose name contains "Off", then apply. The last marker should have the attribute aria-label exactly "Tools turned off: browser.". 2. The picker says what changed and offers to keep it: open the knob. The panel's data-testid "model-picker-tools" should contain the text "browser off", and changed the text "Differs from Default: browser off". 3. Save as new "E2E profile". The last marker should have the attribute aria-label exactly "Profile changed to E2E profile."; changed should be hidden; the profile "E2E profile" should have aria-checked="true". 4. Edit profiles, then click the button whose name contains "Edit" in the row "E2E profile". The dialog's ".modal-title" should have exactly the text "Profile: E2E profile". 5. Click the dialog's radio whose name contains "Custom". Fill the prompt with "Be brief in {{.WorkingDir}}." (those braces are text to type, not a placeholder). The prompt's accessible description (the text of the elements its aria-describedby names) should become exactly "Line 1: unknown variable .WorkingDir", and save should be disabled. 6. Fill the prompt with "Be brief in {{.WorkingDirectory}}.": save should be enabled. Click save: the dialog's ".modal-title" should have exactly the text "Profiles". Press Escape: the dialog should be hidden. 7. The conversation still has the old prompt; Revert takes the profile's: open the knob. Changed should contain the text "Differs from E2E profile: system prompt". Click changed's button whose name contains "Revert". The last marker should have the attribute aria-label exactly "System prompt changed."; changed should be hidden; the panel should be visible; the profile "E2E profile" should have keyboard focus; the last marker should contain the text "new system prompt". 8. Call "last system prompt": it must return "ok". There should be exactly 1 ".system-prompt-view" inside data-testid "generation-context". 9. Click the profile "Default". The last marker should have the attribute aria-label exactly "Profile changed to Default; tools turned on: browser; system prompt changed.", and there should still be exactly 1 ".system-prompt-view" inside data-testid "generation-context".

steps.expression: (() => { const t = document.querySelector('[role=dialog] textarea[aria-label="System prompt template"]'); return (t.getAttribute('aria-describedby') || '').split(/\s+/).filter(Boolean).map((id) => document.getElementById(id)?.textContent.trim() ?? '').join(' '); })()

steps.text: Differs from E2E profile: system prompt

steps.value: Profile changed to Default; tools turned on: browser; system prompt changed.
